topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the core learning objectives and framing cancer as an evolutionary process influenced by mutations, cell types, and microenvironments.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Drivers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how tumors arise through Darwinian clonal selection driven by both genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cells
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how normal tissue stem cell hierarchies and cancer stem cell properties influence tumor initiation and progression across different cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences and Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments cooperate with cellular mutations to drive cancer evolution and sustain tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the lecture and previews the upcoming session on therapy.
